title: Hope for Wildlife
description: A new volunteer steps up to the challenge; Hope's first fawn of the year interrupts delicate surgery on an injured owl.

title: Ontario Hubs: Interstitials
description: Jeyan visits the Ottawa Forest and Nature School, where students spend most of their day outdoors exploring and learning.

title: All-Round Champion
description: It's Jai's week to coach; he and Olympic medalist Rosie MacLennan teach the athletes tricks and flips to help them succeed in trampolining; the prank war heats up again.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine dreams of playing the sax in the theater; when she wakes up, she writes down the notes on a musical score and prepares a concert; just as the concert begins, the wind blows the score away; she can only find a piece with four notes.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Bob Dog quits fetching after losing the "Fastest Fetcher" game show.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Emily Elizabeth and Samantha pretend to be reporters and write their own newspaper, but nothing newsworthy seems to be going on.

title: Colourblocks
description: It's lunchtime in Colourland; Red invites her friends for lunch, where they try each other's favourite foods.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: Bamboo Love learns how to play the Jal Tarang, an Indian melodic percussion instrument consisting of ceramic bowls tuned with varying water levels. Bamboo Love realizes that to play this instrument, one taps the edge of each bowl with Bamboo sticks.

title: Wolf Joe
description: When Smudge the puppy goes missing, Nina, Joe and Buddy interrupt their outdoor gymnastic practice and track his paw prints up to where he's stuck on a rocky ledge.

title: Odo
description: Odo celebrates "Dad Day" with his dad, following the Dad Night Manual; they try double bass lessons, owl-vision from a tall tree, a blackberry feast, and Pinecone Pop-Up; by day's end, they realize the ultimate owltastic thing: combining Pinecone Pop-Up with the double bass! Mum watches in awe as Odo bounces pinecones on the strings while Dad plays, and she declares it the most owltastic thing ever.

title: Pip and Posy
description: Posy becomes overly attached to her gingerbread figure, Mrs. Crunchybum; Pip feels frustrated about constantly having to play games with them both.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: One day the kittens are playing outside and see their friend Smudge who is on his way to his karate class; Cookie wants to be a karate master and tells everyone about his great skills before he takes his first class thinking he can learn on his own!

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Frizzy is convinced that alien koalas are invading Kangaroo Beach when she notices mysterious moving objects and strange sand patterns.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes notice all the animals being mischievously pranked in the valley; following a series of clues, they discover the Dragonfruitflyus as the culprit.

title: Riley Rocket
description: Tensions in the band are at an all-time high, as a trapped Megablast has decided to break up; through some laughter and reflection, they realize they're not just a band but best friends.

title: Isadora Moon
description: Isadora wants to impress her cousins, but her overconfidence leads her to charm three mischievous brooms that create havoc.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Mr. Park's rooftop garden catches fire and there's no water in Adventure Bay; a trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.

title: Interstellar Ella
description: Slippy is super excited about being selected to enter the Young Inventors Competition alongside Angelie. But when the pressure starts to get to him, he over-thinks and over-complicates his invention, which in turn jeopardises the whole competition! Then, when Ella's tasked by Angelie to work with a robot, she quickly bonds with it, naming her Frankie and discovering she can do so much more than she was programmed for.

title: Burps, Butts and Bones
description: A medical skeleton named Bones answers body-related questions that are sent in by real-life children, while a squad of kid reporters known as the B Team find out more about the topic.

title: Happy Travels
description: Nova and her friends Pip, Teddy, Cookie and Doug embark on a hot-air-balloon adventure across Canada. As they soar over famous landmarks, incredible wildlife, and breathtaking landscapes, an unexpected wind sends them on an unforgettable detour through Canada's northern territories.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: The lonely Wandering Sigh is oblivious to B.O.T. as it scuffs sadly through Craggy, Sandy World; the Sigh's search for happiness finally resolves and B.O.T. is able to collect data on more than one Wandering Sigh.

title: Odd Squad
description: Ozzie and Orli must stop the villainous Knights of the Square Table from turning things to stone; Ozzie and Orli time travel to save Odd Squad.

title: Work It Out Wombats!
description: Malik makes Snout less stinky; the Wombats and their friends make a special thank-you treat for Super.

title: ScienceXplosion
description: Eric learns how the four steps of the scientific method work together to find and test the answers to many questions.

title: The Screen Team
description: After Leia's photos mysteriously disappear, she and Reid set out to find the cloud. They take a trip to Equinix, a real data center, to discover where digital files actually live and how they're stored and shared.

title: Colourblocks
description: Set in the world of Colorland, characters Red, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Orange and Green embark on colorful adventures; they discover the world overflows with color.

title: The Singalings
description: Come and read with Harmony, Melody and Bop in the library, but be careful not to make too much noise! You can read so many stories in the library, there are enough books for everyone.

title: Mia & Codie
description: Mia and her bro-bot Codie turn the ordinary into the extraordinary as Mia grows as a coder, thinker, big sister and learns more about coding her world.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: While playfully plucking elastic bands, Bamboo Love finds joy in the twanging sounds that they make. But when she hears a soothing sound, Bamboo love is hypnotized and follows the melodic sound to her friend Giraffe, who plays an instrument called the harp. Snapping out of the trance, Bamboo Love learns to strum, pluck and play the harp.

title: Numberblocks
description: Five and friends discover a hole that makes their heads fall off; they learn how to count up and down and how to add to five with the Numberblocks.

title: ABC With Kenny G
description: Kenny G sings about the letter Y to his usual crowd of animals, yodeling about yams, yoga and yo-yos.

title: The Coco Boo
description: Yoyo wants to paint a flower she has never painted before but can't find one!

title: Polly Can Do
description: Polly and her friends have turned the Forest Fort into their very own castle that they must protect from the scary dragon and a dragon pup - aka Polly and Boo! But the unexpected appearance of a real eight-legged 'monster' leads Polly to come up with a plan for Bella the Knight to overcome her fear of spiders and save the game.

title: ABC SingSong
description: A song about the word nervous.

title: JoJo & Gran Gran
description: After visiting Jared's shop, JoJo and Gran Gran set up their own shop at home.

title: BooSnoo!
description: A unique blend of calm and exploration provides the chance to reset as a red ball embarks on a fantastical adventure filled with art and creativity.

title: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
description: Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster encourage Brad to believe in the power of his imagination; Edmonia Lewis inspires Xavier to create a piece of art for his mom that represents their family.

title: Raven's Quest
description: Cheveyo, Halidzox, and Kimowan are three siblings who live with their family on an island not far from Tofino, B.C.; they are Ahousaht, one of the fourteen Nuu-chah-nulth First Nations; they get to their home by boat and love to play in the ocean.

title: Wordsville
description: After Artist Clay's UNIQUE sculpture is swiped, everything and everyone becomes ordinary and dull duplicates of things they have seen before.

title: PAW Patrol
description: A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire.

title: Audrey's Shelter
description: The Shelter faces a water shortage in the middle of a heat wave, and everyone is at work to keep the animals cool; when Audrey notices that Babou, the proboscis monkey, is wet from head to toe, she's sure he's found a hidden watering hole.

title: Interstellar Ella
description: When Ella heads out to collect space materials for the clubhouse, she borrows Slippy's luckiest good luck charm, Mooncake; Slippy overloads his new rocket boosters and crashes on Jupiter's moon with Madhu.

title: Wolf Joe
description: Nina is missing a moccasin she needs for powwow workout class and jumps to the conclusion that Smudge the puppy has taken it.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: When Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes' yummy drops get snatched by a group of Beetrootsaurus, a game of Pea-in-the-Middle begins to get them back.

title: JoJo & Gran Gran
description: When Gran Gran teaches JoJo all about volcanoes, Gran Gran has a plan; why don't they make a mini volcano of their own?

title: Animanimals
description: The woodpecker pecks a lot of holes trying to catch the cheeky red beetle.

title: The Game Catchers
description: The Game Catchers land on Book Planet, where they learn the game Tower of Cups. But the game is interrupted after a lost Sparkstar needs help finding the book it came from! Then, the Game Catchers land on the Clothes Planet, where they learn the game Shadow Stomper. But the game is interrupted after a lonely travelling jumbo sock's shadow takes over!

title: Olga da Polga
description: Olga thinks there's a snake in the garden; she's proved wrong when she finds out the snake is just the garden hose; how is she going to tell the others she got it wrong?

title: Pip and Posy
description: Pip decides to become Super-Pip in order to help his friends but keeps accidentally spoiling their fun; Posy becomes his side-kick Hero-sy Posy to make sure he only helps those who actually need it.

title: Dr. Cheddar
description: Felix hears some noises in his house, and is convinced it's a ghost; he calls Dr. Cheddar, and together they try to find a reasonable explanation for the sounds.

title: Bamboo Loves Parasports
description: Learning about parasport wheelchair basketball, Bamboo Love dribbles, shoots and wheels down the court in a wheelchair with the help of expert wheelchair basketball player Polar Bear.

title: Woolly Woolly
description: Lila hopes that she and Marco won't get too bored spending summer at home rather than seeing their friends at school every day; Josie is planning to hit the road like in her good old days, but her loved ones count a lot on her in Woollywood.

title: Super Mighty Makers
description: Jordan wants to craft something that will make her 97-year-old great-grandmother more comfortable when she's sitting.

title: Tiny and Tall
description: Tall is delighted to discover a cute creature in a cave. But when the creature follows him home, followed by additional cute creatures, Tall and Tiny find themselves in over their heads!

title: Caillou
description: Caillou and Rosie travel to a farm with Grandma and Grandpa; Caillou packs toys for the trip but leaves them behind; he must find ways to entertain himself during the journey.

title: Urban Tails
description: Lucky the Wood Mouse is a clever cool creature; when she is out foraging, she picks up conspicuous objects like twigs and leaves leaving a trail for herself to find her way home, just like dropping breadcrumbs in a fairytale.

title: Animanimals
description: The ladybird has a ladybird neighbor who has a bit too much in common with him.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Panda's pals cheer him on during "Masked Veggies.".

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes seek shelter in a cave during a wild snowstorm, but it looks like other Vegesaurs had the same idea.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Reading a comic book late at night, Frizzy is convinced she saw an alien koala spaceship; the Cadets camp out overnight on Boomerang Island; Frizzy goes on a late-night hunt for an alien koala.

title: Arthur
description: Prunella is directing the third-grade's production of "The Princess and the Pea," but nothing seems to go according to her plan; D.W. is determined to watch a new television show after her parents tell her she's too young to watch.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Rosie and Javi's pirate adventure goes awry; Rosie has trouble choosing a job at the first Fun Club meeting.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Jack, a natural talent at every sport, gets upset when the gang learns to surf, and he isn't an expert right away.

title: Odd Squad
description: Olympia and Otis must call a truce between feuding guests.

title: Wild Kratts
description: Martin and Chris encounter what could be the last largest lobster.

description: An 11-year-old girl with anxiety finds peace of mind and joy with a therapy horse named Thunder. Then, let's play dress up - with therapy horses! Finally, a 10-year-old girl with ADHD finds her passion amongst the llamas at an animal-assisted therapy farm.

description: The kids want to paint a mural outside the library, but they can't decide what to paint; Mr. Hugo reads them a story about a treasure-hunting mermaid who discovers there's more than one way to solve a problem.

title: Big Top Academy
description: Sir Rayne's appointed headmaster brings new initiatives and rules and forms an elite team for the academy's best.

title: Ainara's Bookshelf
description: Ainara looks into "The Witch Boy," one of her favorite comfort reads; she jets off to Los Angeles to meet up with artist and author Molly Knox Ostertag to talk about comics and why it's important to follow one's true nature.

title: Chatsworth House: A Great British Year
description: Chatsworth is in deep lockdown and learning to live life under the new normal; the community rallies, the estate farm shop becomes a much-needed delivery service.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: Mufflers, honks, and drilling make up the perpetual soundscape of Toronto; fed up with sleepless nights, a couple of activists take the fight to city hall in the hopes of changing the outdated noise bylaws.

title: Life on Wheels
description: Life on Wheels tells the compelling story of a culture on the verge of a transformation; the film addresses the promises and absurdities of our auto-centric transportation system and explores possibilities for change; it examines our core values, freedom, health, safety, and happiness and looks at our cities and our behavior; the path we choose will have a profound impact on future generations.

title: The Total Trust
description: Examining surveillance technology, abuse of power and censorship through the stories of people in China who have been monitored, intimidated and tortured with the use of Big Data and AI.

title: Nathan-ism
description: At the end of World War II, Nathan Hilu, the son of Syrian Jewish immigrants to New York, receives a life-changing assignment from the U.S. Army. This experience fueled a lifetime of artistic inspiration for Nathan.

description: Gymnastics is next, and the athletes take on the uneven bars; Olympic champion Kyle Shewfelt coaches alongside Carter, who shows the athletes the proper technique to succeed; an advantage helps Sierra achieve her goal.

description: The steps to make different floral plant designs using clay to mold petals, stems and leaves.

description: It is easy to become frustrated because a computer or tablet isn't working properly; technology can be like that sometimes and may just need a reboot or time to cool down.

title: Ladybird and Bee
description: After a storm in Wild Meadow, Ladybird and Bee go to meet some new neighbors.

title: Urban Tails
description: In his video for, "Oh Deer," Grandmaster Buck gives a concert performance in the park for all his fellow fallow deer; every king needs a crown and this deer has palm-shaped antlers with several points, his pride and joy.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: The library is having its annual story time sleepover and all the kids are excited to spend the whole night on the library floor with Mrs. Clayton, but Pablo feels nervous without his nightlight.

title: Dr. Cheddar
description: Annie and Felix decide to put on one of their favorite plays, but they both want to play the role of the cow.

title: Canada Crew
description: Bebe and Mo get stuck inside the lodge because of the rain, and they learn about the seasons from a climatologist; Gavin gets lost in the Grand Banks.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Donkey and Panda search for Mooing Moon Moths.

title: Be With Zee
description: Zee encounters a Doddle - a fluffy animal they very much want to pet - but the small creature is wary of Zee.

title: The Very Small Creatures
description: Green discovers a new game with different-sized holes to fit different-sized carrots.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Minty tries to fly and is mistaken for a baby Bokchoydactyl by its mother, who takes Minty back to her nest; Ginger needs a rescue plan.

title: The Game Catchers
description: The Game Catchers land on Book Planet, where they learn the game Tower of Cups. But the game is interrupted after a lost Sparkstar needs help finding the book it came from! Then, the Game Catchers land on the Clothes Planet, where they learn the game Shadow Stomper. But the game is interrupted after a lonely travelling jumbo sock's shadow takes over!

title: Bumpadoo!
description: LiLi, with a little help from Edgar, introduces Bumpi to some of the super fun animals you find here on Earth. Some are big and can roar, while others have long arms and swing through trees.

title: M is for Me
description: Meet 6-year-old Makayla! With Chinese, Filipino, and Scottish roots, she celebrates the best of all her cultures. She's a book-loving, cartwheel-spinning kid who adores hanging out with her grandparents!

title: Caillou
description: Caillou accidentally upsets Rosie by not listening when she asks him to stop pushing her on the swings; when Mommy's new plant is mysteriously knocked over, Caillou wants to find the culprit, but he offends his family when he accuses them.

title: Carl the Collector
description: The everyday adventures of Carl, an autistic raccoon, who loves collecting things.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Rosie helps Iggy get ready for his checkup; Rosie wants to play in the new park -- but it is a park for dogs.

title: Flower & Flour
description: Flower is a seven-year-old girl living above her parents' restaurant; by her side is Flour, a cat created from a bag of flour; they live in a multicultural neighborhood and have various experiences together.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star; but when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring; Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom; but when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

title: Audrey's Shelter
description: The kids must find Pearl the clouded leopard before the whole Shelter notices she's missing and starts to panic.

title: Dino Dexter
description: At the pool, Dex solves Dino Experiment 1003, and helps Kayla get her best swimming time yet.

title: 16 Hudson
description: When the new super's kid JJ loses their pet gecko, the kids leap to help and discover there's more to JJ, geckos, moms and friendship than any of them suspected!

title: Woolly Woolly
description: BeeBee and ChooChoo's strawberry hunt goes awry after the bunnies start nibbling on Willy's veggies.

title: Odd Squad
description: Ms. O turns headquarters over to an unlikely crew.

title: Secrets Of The Forest
description: Taviss teams up with superstars from Parks Canada, who guide her through Pacific Rim National Park; Taviss is surprised to learn that while bears may be dangerous if encountered on a hike, it is humans that are the real danger to bears.

title: Wild Kratts
description: A bird called the purple martin causes confusion.

title: MojoSwoptops
description: Didi the tractor is acting strangely, and super secret spies Mojo and Bo are on the case!

title: Tiny and Tall
description: When Tiny and Tall find a well, they decide it must be a wishing well. Pretending to be adventurers, they throw stones in and declare what they'd wish for. But Tiny gets carried away: she can't stop wishing! After all, they're just pretending - why can't she have as many wishes as she wants? But Tall likes it when stories have rules. They debate the pros and cons of unlimited wishes, finally deciding that five wishes is the perfect amount.

title: The Treebees
description: A Treebees variation on the Japanese nursery rhyme that uses onomatopoeia to describe the different sounds instruments make.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: One September morning, the kittens dream of how they would spend the day flying a kite, going to the playground and playing badminton; the kittens rush to go outside but realize it is too cold to do their favorite summer activities in the fall.

title: Urban Tails
description: Seeing how Flava Frog is the top frog in the pond today, she struts about the pond teaching the complex life cycle of the frog and shows her amazing ability to leap high in the sky.

title: Momolu and Friends
description: Momolu, a gentle panda, helps his friends with their problems.

title: ABC SingSong
description: It's the time of year when snowmen appear and snowflakes dance in the air. It's a song about the word winter!

title: Pip and Posy
description: Pip and Posy accidentally upset Zac while playing a scary storm game; they show him that storms aren't anything to be afraid of.

title: Colourblocks
description: The Colorblocks attempt to solve a rainbow puzzle with the help of new friends Indigo and Violet; the Colorblocks discuss the seven colors of the rainbow.

title: Ladybird and Bee
description: Ladybird and Bee learn that babysitting can be tiring; they are babysitting the Mouse Babies.

title: Curious Crafting
description: Mandisa shows Gabriela and Michael how to craft an extra fun type of slime-- floam slime; the kids stir their ingredients and add white foam beads to give the slime its crunchy texture.

title: Odo
description: Welcoming kids ages three to five to a world full of possibilities and teaching how to deal with setbacks in a meaningful way while promoting the development of self-efficacy and self-confidence.

title: Green Squad
description: Annika's almost 11, loves trees, and wants to protect them-but how? Enter the Green Squad! Together, they plan a tree-themed birthday bash with a twist: it's also a fundraiser for endangered trees like the majestic hemlock. From treetop trekking (even Eric faces his fear of heights!) to crafting forest-inspired decorations and creating pocket forest loot bags with real native trees, Annika learns how fun and impactful eco-action can be.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: The friends are playing music together, but when it's Doodoowah's turn, he just stays silent and doesn't play at all; Doodoowah gets up and walks off, leading them all to a place where they have no choice but to be quiet.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine and Jambo describe how tempo works by singing at different speeds.

title: The Wacky Word Show
description: Zoey and Lukas explore some of the persuasive techniques and language used in advertising and how they're similar to magic tricks.

title: Step by Step Let's Dance
description: Dancers learn how to jive and perform their routine on a breezy tropical island.

title: Animanimals
description: The mammoths will soon be extinct.

title: Trading Skills
description: Akeylah makes her way to Thunder Bay to meet Alicia, a general machinist. Akeylah helps Alicia run through a lengthy list of work orders all while learning about the cool and powerful machines that help shape and repair metal parts. Akeylah uses a radial drill press to drill a big hole in a piston. Akeylah gets a turn to use Alicia's favourite machine, a manual lathe.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin, Francois, observe a pair of mountain goats when a sudden avalanche strikes; Farmer Al finds mysterious crop circles in his corn field, so he calls on the "PAW Patrol" to find out who is making them.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: B.O.T. accidentally shocks the Fluffy Trembler causing its fluff to fly off; the Fluffy Trembler is distraught; to cheer up the beastie and complete this mission, B.O.T. must collect the fluff and return it to the tearful Trembler.

title: MojoSwoptops
description: Jackson's sheep ruins Preston's flower festival, unless Mojo and Bo can round them up!

title: Dream It to Be It
description: Eight-year-old Joshua loves gymnastics and challenging himself with new moves!; his dream is to be an accomplished acrobat and aerial artist!; with the help of Tai and Wesley from The Toronto Circus School, Joshua learns if he has what it takes to soar on the silks!

description: Abby meets her best Fuzzly friend, Bozzly, for the first time; when the hotel's salon owner, Mrs. Melvin, closes the salon for the day, Abby tries to help Harriet, a hair-obsessed Fuzzly, find a new hobby.

title: Urban Tails
description: MC Moley, the European Mole, is ready to wax lyrical on his super fresh track: "Moley Moley Mole.".

description: When Mummy's at work, JoJo asks what a job is; while Gran Gran explains, they realize Mummy accidentally took Gran Gran's phone; JoJo's job is to visit Mummy to fix the mix-up!

description: Set in the world of Colorland, characters Red, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Orange and Green embark on colorful adventures; they discover the world overflows with color.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: The kittens play with their toy car when suddenly, the wheel comes off; their friend Dart says that he can try to fix it.

description: Lila tries to map the way home from school, but it's not that easy; after a night spent in the country nearby, Choochoo, Josie and Willie wake up on the top of a mountain; finding their way back to their village turns out to be quite an adventure.

description: Bondini and Maria help Holden bring the outdoors in for his mom.

description: Harry smells - he needs a bath! He learns the importance of good hygiene and how it affects his friendships.

title: Cutie Pugs
description: Dee Dee and the pugs play in the puddles, and get covered in mud.

description: Opie is desperate to show his family the cool science he is learning at school. But since he can't bring them to his class, Opie decides to go on a science hunt around the house and bring science home to them.

description: Jasmine has written a song and wants to sing it with the Lalalas, but they sound really bad; Jasmine tries to give them the right instructions, but it doesn't work and she despairs.

description: Caillou feels helpless after Grandma hurts her ankle, so he imagines trying to help a sneezy Rexy; Caillou and Leo are pretending to be air show pilots when Leo accidentally bumps into Caillou and breaks his toy plane.

description: Duck's magic trick goes awry, turning her neighbors' things into pickles; Donkey is afraid to scooter after a fall.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Four junior lifeguards work under the guidance and encouragement of mature lifeguards to become heroes of Kangaroo Beach.

title: Arthur
description: The new kid in town charms Arthur and friends with her stories.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Rosie tries to be a reporter but has trouble finding things that are newsworthy; Rosie and Jun believe there is a jalapeño giant on the loose.

title: High Hoops
description: Aoife is tall and gangly and wants to be cool and popular; if she can turn her school's hopeless basketball team into winners, can she reinvent herself at the same time?

title: Wild Kratts
description: Martin and Chris must take Aviva's new Creature Power Challenge when they argue over who gets to keep a creature souvenir.

title: All-Round Champion
description: The athletes learn snow kiting from Chace and Red Bull Ragnarok Champion Marie-Eve Mayrand; they quickly realize this is the toughest sport yet when they struggle to navigate the winds.

title: Old Enough!
description: Brother-sister team, Nehemiah and Nyah, battle the rain; three-year-old Jasper has a tall list of tasks for a small tot.

title: Evolve
description: Patrick goes in search of animals that have mastered the art of protection and discovers how their genius is inspiring new technologies to protect people in the future.

title: GeoMinute
description: On December 6, 1921, Agnes MacPhail became the first woman elected to the House of Commons; throughout her long political career, MacPhail championed the rights of women, immigrants, prisoners and other marginalized groups despite critics who accused her of communism and attributed her views to her womanly sympathy.

title: Hope for Wildlife
description: Hope's first fawn of the season is doing better than expected, while a goose receives care at the Burnside Veterinary Hospital following a potentially fatal encounter; more than 60 raccoons are now in rehab.
